definitions.explanation: Something that must happen and cannot be avoided.

examples.japanese: {必然|ひつぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{必然的|ひつぜんてき}→必然的：18497_hitsuzenteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧。
⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{必然|ひつぜん}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

notes:
{必然|ひつぜん} refers to something that must happen—inevitability or necessity by natural law or logic.

FORMS:
- ⟦{必然的|ひつぜんてき}→必然的：18497_hitsuzenteki⟧(な): inevitable (na-adjective)
- ⟦{必然的|ひつぜんてき}→必然的：18497_hitsuzenteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: inevitably (adverb)
- ⟦{必然性|ひつぜんせい}→必然性：12691_hitsuzensei⟧: inevitability, necessity (abstract noun)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {必然|ひつぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: an inevitable result
- ⟦{必然的|ひつぜんてき}→必然的：18497_hitsuzenteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}こる→起こる：01910_okoru⟧: to happen inevitably
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{必然|ひつぜん}: historical inevitability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {必然|ひつぜん}: inevitability (must happen)
- ⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧: chance, coincidence (happens by accident)
